---
title: "Modernization Roadmap"
date: 2026-08-17
---

The program: make the JHEEM ecosystem legible, testable, and observable — for humans and agents — without ever betting the science on an untested change. Status updates land here as work completes; rationale for the ordering lives in the [decision log](decisions.qmd).

## Where we stand (August 2026)

The ecosystem is a barbell. One end: a scientifically sophisticated core (`jheem2`, ~75k lines) with no automated tests, no CI, mega-files, and folklore APIs. The other end: delivery infrastructure that is above industry standard (digest-promoted containers with golden tests, release-versioned data, the portal). The missing middle is the work. Two prior proofs — the syphilis-manager CI and the container platform — show modern practice already succeeds in this ecosystem.

A Dec 2025 refactor attempt (package extraction on a long-lived branch, tests deferred) stalled after one week of work and is being mined for parts, not merged ([D-002](decisions.qmd)). Team-requested payoffs shaping this program: real documentation with runnable examples, and calibration observability.

### Next

- **Quickstart vignette** on the toy fixture (spec → engine → simulate → plot), executed in CI.
- **`@examples` on the top ~50 exports**, chosen by usage-grep of `jheem_analyses`/`jheem2_interactive` — doubles as API curation (public vs. `@keywords internal`).
- **pkgdown site** for jheem2, linked from this wiki.
- **Graceful-stop hook** for calibration (sentinel checked at cache writes) — only after the test net exists.
- **Graduate census + surveillance managers** into the syphilis CI pattern ([D-004](decisions.qmd)).
- **Wiki goes public** — GitHub Pages, later `docs.jheem.org` — once it informs rather than confuses.

### Later / deferred

- **Structural decomposition of jheem2** ([D-003](decisions.qmd)) — revisit after API curation and tests; extraction becomes cheap and optional rather than heroic.
- **Platform org-ownership migration** and a **second operator** able to run at least one delivery workflow end-to-end (bus-factor mitigation; coupled to [D-010](decisions.qmd)).
- Retire source-mode loading of jheem2 in favor of `library()` + `devtools::load_all()`.
- Format-versioned data-manager representation (reduce serialized-R6 fragility).
- Hygiene sweep: `browser()` calls behind a debug flag, condition-object error capture replacing `.GlobalEnv` writes, `R/tests` and `R/beta_code` moved out of `R/`.

## Success criteria

- Any jheem2 PR gets an automated verdict (check + regression) before merge.
- A new person — or an agent — runs the quickstart end-to-end in under 30 minutes with nothing but the package.
- A running calibration can be inspected (likelihood behavior, mixing, per-city status) without asking anyone.
- The ecosystem map exists, is current, and is linked from every repo's `CLAUDE.md`/README.
- A three-month interruption costs re-reading this wiki, not re-deriving it.

## Standing risks

- **Doc-momentum trap:** the Dec 2025 effort produced ~4,800 lines of plans and one week of code. Mitigation: wiki work is time-boxed; every planning increment is paired with a landed code change.
- **Fixture turns out hard:** fallback recorded in [D-008](decisions.qmd).
- **Solo-effort sustainability:** interruption-tolerance is a design requirement — small merges, state in the wiki, agents re-orient from the map.
- **Two-speed masking:** platform polish must not substitute for core legibility; both ends of the barbell move.
